corrections.reason: In the zoomed image and canonical Ge'ez Psalm citation ('ርእዩከ ማያት እግዚኦ ርእዩከ ማያት ወፈርሁ'), the second character is clearly 6th-order 'እ' (ርእዩከ), matching the repeated verb at the end of the line.
Wait, let's check the glyph at the end of Col 1 L27: it is ዕድው (Ge'ez imperative 'cross over!', glossed in L29 as 'ተሻግረህ ሂድ'). Let's fix to ዕድው.
Ge'ez imperative 'ሑር ዕድው ለዝንቱ ዮርዳኖስ' ('Go, cross over this Jordan', glossed immediately in Amharic as 'ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግረህ ሂድ'); visually the final glyph is 'ው' misread as 'ም'.
In the zoomed image of Col 1 L38, the word has only three characters: 'ድኗል' (ድ-ኗ-ል), not four ('ድነዋል').
The printed glyph in Col 2 L14 is 'ህ' (መምህረ), the standard spelling of 'መምህር'.
In Col 3 L04, the printed glyph is 'እኛን' ('እኛን ከመጥቀም በላይ እሱን ከመጥቀም በታች ነውና'), parallel to 'እሱን ከመጥቀም' in L05.
Looking closely at Col 3 L26 in the zoomed image, the word is 'እንዲህ' ('ትንቢቱን አውቆ አናግሯል ምሳሌውንም እንዲህ አውቆ አስመስሏል'), where 'ዲህ' was compressed/misread as 'ጂ'.
